SOP Control PostureLink

SOP ControlCurrent StandardFounder Use
StatusACTIVE SOPUse as the operating standard for system rollout, habit formation, adoption checks, and maturity gates.
PurposeMove UNYRA from setup into sustained use quality across CRM, operations, compliance, dashboards, SOPs, archive, and working-file custody.Keeps the founder focused on behavior change, not just document polish.
Source ruleReview adoption board, control routing matrix, control integrity review, executable-check board, owner accountability, task tracker, funding review, release review, and linked functional dashboards before declaring maturity.Prevents the system from being called adopted while live gates still rely on memory.
Decision ruleAdoption exists only when teams use the correct control layer before decisions, movement changes, live gates, or founder approvals.Blocks after-the-fact documentation from masquerading as operating discipline.
Template protectionKeep live working copies outside protected template folders and preserve approved template masters while adoption practices mature.Protects 01_templates/ and approved standards during rollout pressure.

Adoption PrincipleLink

PrincipleRequired Adoption BehaviorFounder Reading
Structure is not enoughBeautiful structure does not equal adoption unless the correct layer is used before decisions.A polished room is only useful when it changes behavior under pressure.
Operating habit is the maturity testNaming, routing, refresh discipline, owner follow-through, and closeout behavior become normal.Adoption should reduce founder rescue rather than document it.
Live gates require executable proofTrust-linked release, payment, shipment, or communication logic opens the executable-check layer before movement widens.Same-day pressure is the real adoption exam.
Source discipline comes before polishDashboards are trusted only after linked source records are current and decision-ready.Dashboard confidence must stay downstream of proof.
Closeout quality proves maturityShipment review, profitability, CAPA, archive, and lesson capture close as strongly as the system opens.Adoption is incomplete if work opens formally but closes from memory.

Rollout Phase ModelLink

PhaseFounder StandardPass SignalHold Signal
Structure setupFolders, portals, templates, rooms, dashboards, and preview surfaces exist with protected masters preserved.Navigation is clear and protected templates stay untouched.Teams still ask where a matter belongs.
Guided useFounder or operating owner routes live issues into the correct layer before action.Teams can follow the control route with founder prompting.Decisions still begin in chat or memory.
Habit formationOwners open source rooms, dashboards, tasks, release gates, and executable checks without founder chase.Control usage appears before movement, payment, or communication.Records are refreshed only after the founder asks.
Stress testSame-day release, funding, supplier response, claim, or customer pressure uses the correct gate under urgency.Executable-check and control-integrity records stay current while pressure is live.Urgency creates shortcuts or fragmented stop rules.
MaturityThe system reduces founder rescue, preserves proof, and closes work with archive-ready evidence.Owners, deadlines, source records, dashboards, and closeout paths agree without founder reconstruction.Founder still acts as missing owner, memory, or evidence router.

Warning SignsLink

Warning SignWhy It MattersRequired Founder Response
Chat-first decisionsTeams make decisions before opening the right review layer.Route the matter through control routing before action continues.
Template contaminationWorking files appear in 01_templates/.Move live work into owned rooms and preserve protected masters.
Repeated founder exceptionsOne matter accumulates exceptions without exception governance.Open exception governance and owner accountability before further movement.
Stale source recordsA dashboard looks polished while linked source rooms are stale.Refresh source rooms and run control integrity before decision.
Executable-check bypassRelease, payment, shipment, or communication widens while the executable-check layer is stale, missing, or only in chat.Stop widening and require executable-check routing.
Containment without closureCases are contained but not closed through profitability, CAPA, shipment review, or archive logic.Keep matter active until closeout proof is route-backed.
Founder rescue becomes routineThe founder keeps supplying owner memory, deadlines, or proof location.Move the pattern into owner accountability and adoption review.

StepRequired Founder ResponseControl Route
Route the issuePut the issue into the correct control layer before further action.06_dashboard/33_control-routing/Founder-Control-Routing-Matrix.md

Do not normalize shortcutDo not reward the shortcut just because it solved today’s pressure.06_dashboard/32_exception-governance/Executive-Exceptions-and-Override-Review.md

Live-Gate Adoption StandardLink

Gate TypeRequired Before Movement WidensAdoption Failure
Release gateRelease record, executable-check board, scenario response, risk register, and source room carry the same current answer.Broker handoff or movement widens because packet exists.
Funding gateFunding release, cash outlook, release gate, packet proof, and executable-check record agree.Supplier payment moves because urgency or relationship pressure rises.
Customer communication gateCommunication control, response SLA, trust posture, and counterparty room agree before outward language leaves.Message is sent from chat or memory without release controls.
Supplier response gateSupplier packet, response escalation, supplier performance, and supply resilience agree.Supplier confirmation compresses the decision window and the system catches up later.
Archive gateShipment review, document control, task closure, executable-check proof, and archive closeout agree.Matter is treated as finished before retrieval proof exists.

Monthly Adoption CheckLink

Monthly Check StepRequired ActionMaturity Standard
Refresh linked controlsRefresh founder dashboard, control routing matrix, control integrity review, owner accountability, executable-check board, task tracker, funding review, release review, and linked functional dashboards first.Adoption is judged from current evidence, not static structure.
Open adoption boardOpen 06_dashboard/35_system-adoption/Operating-System-Adoption-and-Readiness-Board.md.The board becomes the monthly maturity scorecard.
Judge use qualityDecide whether the system reduces founder rescue, improves closure quality, keeps work inside right layers, and opens executable checks before live movement widens.Usage quality matters more than folder count.
Apply maturity gateDo not call the operating system mature until disciplined use quality holds without founder forcing.Founder is no longer the missing executable-check owner at live gates.
Record next adoption actionPut the next gap into owner accountability, adoption board, or weekly review.Adoption issues become managed work, not private frustration.
